summary.text: Don Dewitt is the Republican candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 6, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He defeated incumbent Jeffrey Stephens in the Republican primary on May 12, 2026.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a retired detective sergeant and former chief of police.

paragraphs.text: Dewitt earned a bachelor's degree from West Liberty State College in 1991.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as working as a security officer.
In the survey, he said he has lived in Moundsville for more than 25 years and served the community as a police officer for 25 years.
Dewitt said in the survey that he would support legislation that is tougher on crime, including long-term in-house treatment for people with addiction and harsh penalties for drug dealers.
He also said he wants to focus on government spending and the economy, and on improving the state's education system.
